name: context-notes
description: Triage the notes captured in a project's Notion Mind Palace: read what is new since the last run, decide where each note belongs — a GitHub issue, a Notion row, a thread, a handoff item or the shortlist — and write it there after approval. Which palace and which organisations come from the project's state.notes in its .claude/workspace.json, with no default, so one install serves every project without ever crossing an org boundary.
